# Chute, phase 3 (run with --no-save): the game's parts. chute_body.glb is everything but the disc
# (the static chutes); the disc alone, origin at its centre and moved to the origin, is
# sign_red.glb, then recoloured: sign_green.glb (green, cream rings), sign_cream.glb (cream,
# plum ring). The game flips and swaps the discs between the chutes. Generated by make_chute.py.
select Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3 Hopper Post RimF RimB RimL RimR Sack Tie Frill
export chute_body.glb --selection
cursor set 0 0.75 1.98
select Disc
active Disc
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9 && abs(pos.x) < 0.05 && abs(pos.z) < 0.05"
material assign Sign
mode object
export sign_red.glb --selection
material set Sign base-color 0.3765 0.6824 0.4824
export sign_green.glb --selection
material set Sign base-color 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118
material set Ring base-color 0.3961 0.2510 0.3255
export sign_cream.glb --selection
